title: branch-view
description: Today's view of a branch, from your copy: today's design with every node of the branch its node engineer signed as it is, the nodes left out and why, and every value outside the branch that moves; or why not.

says.description: What the view is: today's design with the branch's signed nodes, not a release.

changes.description: The nodes of the branch taken in that change today's design, by id.

left_out.description: The nodes of the branch not taken, and why.

seal_refuses.description: What the seal would refuse now, each reason as the seal says it: the view runs what is signed, and the seal asks more of each node.

case.description: The case the view ran on.

today.description: How today's design ran on the case: n ran, m blocked, each blocked node with why.

blocked.description: Every node it blocked, inside the branch or not, each with why.

view.description: How the view ran on the case: n ran, m blocked, each blocked node with why, the branch's own nodes among them.

blocked.description: Every node it blocked, inside the branch or not, each with why.

impact.description: Every value outside the branch that moves, with the nearest group it hangs under; null where it refuses or does not run.

before_why.description: Why it refused in today's design, its node's own reason, where it refused.

after_why.description: Why it refused in the view, its node's own reason, where it refused.
